title: T02a — Selection contract: model endpoint and execution worker chosen independently; no silent fallback
goal: Selection contract: model endpoint and execution worker chosen independently; no silent fallback.
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
acceptance: Selection contract: model endpoint and execution worker chosen independently; no silent fallback
validation: Directed regressions or recorded evidence for this slice; final required CI
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T02a of the step "Independent model and execution selection". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent; former 1-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 1.5 h → 1 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept.
